rows.grounds: present passive participle describing one undergoing cutting
optative verb expressing potential or counterfactual cutting
compound describing one who has reached that state
compound describing one whose mind is absorbed in that

items.question: Does absorption in that state prevent injury when one is being cut?
premises: A person may be subjected to the act of cutting.
A person can be gone to that state with mind fixed on it.
Such absorption alters the effect of physical harm.
items.inference: One who has reached that state and whose mind is fixed on it is not cut even while being cut.
uncertainties: Whether the immunity described is literal physical invulnerability or a transcendence of felt injury is not explicit.
items.plain_english: One who has gone to that state, with mind fixed on it, is not cut even while being cut.
